title: [review] lichend.rs: Seed persistence failure silently ignored
description: If `save_seed` fails, the newly generated seed is lost. On next restart, a different seed will be generated, causing identity drift. The node would have a different public key, breaking peer authentication and potentially orphaning mesh routes.
close_reason: Fixed: save_seed failure now fails closed with error log and exit(1), matching epoch persistence pattern. Prevents identity drift on restart.
